# No Mining Trace

**Category:** Player  
**Aliases:** No Mining Trace

## What it does

Allows you to mine blocks through entities.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://github.com/MeteorDevelopment/meteor-client/blob/e3a2e77967629d216e127b5ceecf71fb15f9d2e5/src/main/java/meteordevelopment/meteorclient/systems/modules/player/NoMiningTrace.java).
